articles.title: A U-Boat Killed 763 American Soldiers on Christmas Eve in 1944. The Army Kept It Secret for 50 Years
articles.summary: On Christmas Eve, 1944, a German U-boat tragically sank a transport ship, killing 763 American soldiers. This significant wartime loss was kept secret by the U.S. Army for five decades, only coming to light much later. The prolonged secrecy surrounding the incident highlights the complex nature of wartime information management and its long-term implications for historical understanding.

articles.title: India-EU FTA: Farm, ‘Make in India’ need guardrails
articles.summary: The India-European Union Free Trade Agreement (FTA) is a landmark trade decision for India, establishing significant economic ties between the world's fourth-largest economy and the second-largest. This agreement is expected to boost trade, investment, and market access for Indian goods and services within the EU, fostering economic growth and strengthening bilateral relations on a global stage.

articles.title: All You Need To Know Going Into Trade On Thursday
articles.summary: The GIFT Nifty is trading marginally lower at 25,935.50, indicating a flat to negative open for India's benchmark index. This market update reflects broader global economic sentiment, as US and European index futures show mixed performance during Asian trading hours. Understanding such indicators is crucial for comprehending national economic stability, a vital aspect for aspiring officers.

articles.title: ArXiv says submissions must be in English: are AI translators up for the job?
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence translators are emerging as a crucial tool for researchers worldwide. They can help meet arXiv's new mandate requiring all preprint manuscripts to be submitted in English. This technology facilitates broader access to global scientific research, overcoming language barriers and streamlining the publication process for non-native English speakers, enhancing the dissemination of scientific knowledge.

articles.title: PM Modi to set vision for India’s global role at ET NOW Business Summit in February
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is slated to deliver the keynote address at the ET NOW Global Business Summit 2026, scheduled for February 13-14 in New Delhi. This high-profile event will provide critical insights into India's economic trajectory and business opportunities, attracting global leaders and stakeholders for discussions on national growth and development strategies.

articles.title: Times stops at 8.44am in Baramati, Pawars’ hometown unites in time of grief to salute Dada
articles.summary: Baramati, the hometown of the influential Pawar family, collectively observed a moment of silence at 8:44 am, uniting in shared grief. The community paid tribute to "Dada," signifying a profound loss or remembrance of a highly respected individual. This act underscores the deep impact of the person on Baramati's residents, reflecting a significant local event of honor and remembrance.

articles.title: Everything to See and Do at Disney California Adventure’s Lunar New Year Celebration
articles.summary: Disney California Adventure is hosting its annual Lunar New Year celebration. The event features Disney characters in special Lunar New Year outfits, unique food, exclusive merchandise, and various arts and crafts. Guests can also enjoy vibrant cultural performances, celebrating the festive traditions of the Lunar New Year at the theme park.
